lesson.topic: Japanese numbers 1–10 — kanji / kana / romaji ↔ Bangla
lesson.stt: JlcStt (used by the two speaking games)
lesson.session_scope: LessonSessionScope — rounds/item-count can be overridden per session via the optional sessionRounds param; defaults shown per game below

games.flow: TTS plays a number's kana; learner taps the matching tile out of 4 options (1 correct + 3 distractors).
games.correct_feedback: medium haptic, confetti, green tile highlight, +10 XP, 'correct' banner (~1.3s)
games.wrong_feedback: heavy haptic, shake animation, red tile, streak reset, recorded in missed-map
games.notes: Deck = all 10 shuffled; one pass through the deck = one session. Auto-advances after the correct-answer banner.

games.flow: Reads a prompt in one script and asks for the match in the other. Modes alternate: even rounds = BN→JP (alternating Bangla digit / Bangla word), odd rounds = JP→BN.

modes.label: JP → BN
modes.prompt: এটি বাংলায় কী? — pick the Bangla answer

games.correct_feedback: confetti, green highlight, +10 XP, correct banner; card flip-in animation each round
games.wrong_feedback: shake animation, red highlight, streak reset, missed-map
games.notes: Strict mode alternation drives variety: digit→JP, JP→BN, word→JP, JP→BN, …

games.flow: Ten shuffled number chips must be dragged into the correct slot (slot n accepts number n). Round ends when the pool is empty (all 10 placed).
games.correct_feedback: medium haptic, confetti, chip locks into slot, +10 XP
games.wrong_feedback: heavy haptic, slot shake, streak reset, wrong-attempt + missed[slot] recorded
games.notes: Wrong drops do not consume the chip — learner retries until placed correctly.

games.format: Single speech recording of 1→10, per-position evaluation
games.flow: Learner says all numbers 1 through 10 in Japanese in one recording. STT transcript is tokenized and each spoken token mapped to a number; every position is marked correct / wrong / missed, plus any extras.
games.evaluation: Per-position status: pending / correct / wrong / missed / extra. Token matcher accepts romaji, hiragana, katakana, kanji, and Western/Bangla digits (incl. common STT variants e.g. shi/yo for 4).
games.correct_feedback: confetti on evaluation, per-position color states; tracks best-correct across attempts
games.notes: Hardest production game — no multiple choice; relies on STT. Token matcher is lenient about reading variants.

games.format: Free-play: model audio + mic record + 0–100 pronunciation score
games.flow: A target number is shown with Bangla pronunciation hint. Learner can hear the model (normal/slow), compare native, then record (~5s). The recording is graded 0–100 against kana/romaji/kanji/digit; ≥80 passes.
games.rounds: endless free-play (no fixed round count); 'পরের সংখ্যা' loads next random target
games.scoring: 100 exact; 96 contains kana; 92 contains romaji; 90 contains kanji; 88 contains digit; else similarity*70. Pass ≥80; ≥90 = 'excellent'.
games.xp_display: status badge shows +30 XP if score ≥90 else +20 (display); review tally uses +10 per pass (_totalXp)
games.correct_feedback: light haptic, kana highlight of matched runes, score badge pop, status message
games.notes: Review sheet ('রিভিউ') available once any attempt/miss exists; Play Again resets all tallies.

games.format: 3-column grid of 12 cards (6 pairs): Japanese ↔ Bangla
games.flow: Pick 6 random numbers → 12 cards (a Japanese card and a Bangla card per number), shuffled into a 3-col grid. Tap two cards to match them; Japanese cards play their audio when tapped. Round ends when all pairs matched.
games.correct_feedback: medium haptic, confetti, green match border, +10 XP, check badge
games.wrong_feedback: heavy haptic, red border + shake, streak reset, miss-per-pair recorded
games.notes: Live stopwatch ticks each second. Restart button reshuffles a new board.

games.flow: TTS plays a target kana; learner picks from 4 options against a shared countdown. Ends when the timer expires or max rounds are reached.
games.correct_feedback: medium haptic, confetti, +10 XP, streak grows
games.wrong_feedback: heavy haptic, shake, streak reset, missed-map
games.notes: One shared 25s timer for the whole run; correct/wrong auto-advances after ~0.6s.
